| `ENTASIS_QUERY_VOLUME_ALL`    |   `5` | AABB query that writes all overlapping broad-phase entries |

### `entasis_sweep_hit_state_t`

sweep result states

| Constant             | Value | Meaning                               |
| -------------------- | ----: | ------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_SWEEP_MISS` |   `0` | no impact found in the sweep interval |
| `ENTASIS_SWEEP_HIT`  |   `1` | impact found in the sweep interval    |

### `entasis_timestep_completion_stage_t`

stable timestep completion identifiers

| Constant                                      | Value | Meaning                                            |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----: | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_TIMESTEP_SLEPT`                      |   `0` | sleeping stage completed                           |
| `ENTASIS_TIMESTEP_BEFORE_COLLISION_DETECTION` |   `1` | predicted bounds are ready for collision detection |
| `ENTASIS_TIMESTEP_COLLISIONS_DETECTED`        |   `2` | collision detection completed                      |
| `ENTASIS_TIMESTEP_CONSTRAINTS_SOLVED`         |   `3` | constraint solving and integration completed       |

### `entasis_allocation_scope_t`

implemented allocator reach modes

| Constant                       | Value | Meaning                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------ | ----: | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_ALLOCATION_LEGACY`    |   `0` | retains existing allocator reach and lazy pool metadata growth                                                                                  |
| `ENTASIS_ALLOCATION_ALL_OWNED` |   `1` | routes resource metadata, native blocks and included worker/thread records through the selected allocator. valid buffer returns do not allocate |

### `entasis_body_access_mask_t`

custom constraint body field access

| Constant                               | Value | Meaning                          |
| -------------------------------------- | ----: | -------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_POSITION`         |   `1` | read position                    |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_ORIENTATION`      |   `2` | read orientation                 |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_MASS`             |   `4` | read inverse mass                |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_INERTIA_TENSOR`   |   `8` | read inverse inertia             |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_LINEAR_VELOCITY`  |  `16` | read and update linear velocity  |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_ANGULAR_VELOCITY` |  `32` | read and update angular velocity |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_ACCESS_ALL`              |  `63` | all six body fields              |

### `entasis_constraint_kernel_phase_t`

custom constraint kernel phases

| Constant                                       | Value | Meaning                                   |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ----: | ----------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_CONSTRAINT_KERNEL_PRESTEP`            |   `0` | prepares constraint data before warmstart |
| `ENTASIS_CONSTRAINT_KERNEL_WARMSTART`          |   `1` | applies accumulated impulses              |
| `ENTASIS_CONSTRAINT_KERNEL_SOLVE`              |   `2` | performs one velocity iteration           |
| `ENTASIS_CONSTRAINT_KERNEL_INCREMENTAL_UPDATE` |   `3` | updates between substeps after the first  |

## Functions

### `entasis_abi_version`

returns the runtime C ABI generation used by this library

```c
ENTASIS_API uint32_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_abi_version(void);
```

returns ENTASIS_ABI_VERSION for a compatible runtime library

### `entasis_version_current`

returns the current Entasis product version

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_version_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_version_current(void);
```

returns the runtime product version

### `entasis_status_ok`

returns ENTASIS_TRUE only for ENTASIS_STATUS_OK

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_bool_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_status_ok(entasis_status_t status);
```

| Parameter | C type             | Meaning                    |
| --------- | ------------------ | -------------------------- |
| `status`  | `entasis_status_t` | status to test or describe |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE when status is ENTASIS_STATUS_OK

### `entasis_status_failed`

returns ENTASIS_TRUE for any non-OK status

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_bool_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_status_failed(entasis_status_t status);
```

| Parameter | C type             | Meaning                    |
| --------- | ------------------ | -------------------------- |
| `status`  | `entasis_status_t` | status to test or describe |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE when status is not ENTASIS_STATUS_OK

### `entasis_status_text`

returns a process-lifetime borrowed status string

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_string_view_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_status_text(entasis_status_t status);
```

| Parameter | C type             | Meaning                    |
| --------- | ------------------ | -------------------------- |
| `status`  | `entasis_status_t` | status to test or describe |

returns a borrowed static string describing status

### `entasis_diagnostic_clear`

clears optional caller-owned diagnostic storage

```c
ENTASIS_API void ENTASIS_CALL entasis_diagnostic_clear(entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                   | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *` | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

no return value

### `entasis_diagnostic_record`

records allocation-free cold-path failure context

```c
ENTASIS_API void ENTASIS_CALL entasis_diagnostic_record(entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic, entasis_status_t status, entasis_diagnostic_operation_t operation, int32_t detail);
```

| Parameter    | C type                           | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`         | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |
| `status`     | `entasis_status_t`               | status to test or describe                                                   |
| `operation`  | `entasis_diagnostic_operation_t` | operation category to record                                                 |
| `detail`     | `int32_t`                        | operation-specific diagnostic detail                                         |

no return value

### `entasis_body_handle_is_valid`

checks the body handle sentinel representation

checks representation only, not whether the object is alive. stop using a handle when its object is removed. a reused slot may identify a different object


| Parameter | C type                  | Meaning            |
| --------- | ----------------------- | ------------------ |
| `handle`  | `entasis_body_handle_t` | target body handle |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE when handle is not the invalid body sentinel
